g.text: A linked slide show's state (ADR-0048 §8): main's session, and each window's link — away and back included
a window is being claimed for the audience;
the presenter is already a member
every accepted move: seq + 1, ack to the sender,
retains the path, in no session)
the presenter's show tab closes, its window closes,
reloads or crashes · the audience window
closes, reloads, crashes or its view unmounts ·
the audience window's display is removed
out = {} — nothing of mine is on the way
out ≠ {} — my move is on the way;
a push is HELD, not shown
a push newer than seq → held ·
the last ack → show the held push
only if it is newer than own-seq
(window A: its deck view went, the show's tab open —
another tab, another file in it, Reflow; the show
runs on in B; nothing is sent; applying = nothing)
the deck mounts → the show starts at
:start; known = the start, so nothing is
my own Escape in the show's view, End Slide Show,
the audience's view unmounting or the show's tab
a push newer than seq → known := it
(no [:show]; held and released as in Live) ·
an ack · joined → live, still away
the deck mounts in the show's view → resume:
:from and applying = known's page, known's blank;
the first report equals known, so nothing is sent
ended or refused → the show stops
the show's tab closes · End Slide Show
Fill: where the state is held · Arrow: what triggers it
arrow: a message over the IPC seam
arrow: the window's own view — the deck mounting or unmounting, the engine's report
arrow: a key the person presses
A push whose seq is not newer than the window's seq is dropped (ADR-0046's guard); an ack always clears its mid.
Away and back: ADR-0048 §8.10, theory/11 §3.5 — the model's Unmount and Remount.
